rationale: One agent adds a parameter to `send` in sender.rs and updates the call site it can see in caller.rs. Concurrently the other agent adds a second call site using the old one-argument form. Each file merges cleanly on its own; only pooling definitions and call sites across the merged set reveals that the result does not type-check. This is the cross-file class single-file suites cannot express.
